rca_of_the_issue: Bug #3 RCA: legacy SPOT's auto-flip useEffect (spot_r1_5.jsx L3946) reads sel.bc.{pricable,meetMin,hasPrice} which is the raw auto-select board calc, BEFORE the buy-min useEffect mutates it (separate useEffect runs AFTER). Cloud ran buy-min in the same backend pass and exposed only the POST-buy-min boardHasPrice/boardMeetMin, so the FE useEffect saw `meetMin=true` (lifted by buy-min) and concluded `hasIssue=false`, never triggering the flip. Fix: snapshot the 3 bc flags BEFORE STEP 6 buy_min auto-flip in runner.py, expose them as _pipeline.preBuyMin*, and have ItemSetupSec.jsx auto-flip useEffect read those instead. Verified at runner.py L267-269 (capture) + L400-404 (expose) and ItemSetupSec.jsx L156-171 (consume).
